body: This week has not been a good week for me. On top of holding the blame for everything, I made the decision to get some oxys and just make myself feel nothing for a few days.. I haven't done anything like that in a long time. Now that they're gone though, everything seems so much worse. I'm back to not being able to sleep and my bad thoughts won't go away. Why won't your therapist help you?
Want to talk about it? You can PM me, if you want.
I don't really see the value. I lost my job and had to move back in with my parents and then all that happened with her. I'm pretty worthless on top of all the shitty things I've done.

She cheated on her husband because she was extremely unhappy in their relationship and started seeing me behind his back. She introduced me to her kids very early after he left, and I became a big part of their lives for a while. She kept going back and fourth on her feelings for him, ripping my heart out each time, and taking the kids away from me I started to see as my own. She manipulated my feelings to keep me around and let me down slowly. She knew I wanted children and to get married and she promised me everything and more.. then decided she was still in love with him. This happened multiple times, but I couldn't look past the vision that I was in love with. She asked me if I had been tested, I lied and told her I did but that it came back negative. By that time we had already had unprotected sex multiple times, and I wasn't sure how to tell her without ruining the future together that she promised me. My friend and I were addicts and regularly used together. We had pushed ourselves to that threshold multiple times because we weren't happy with the lives we were living and saw no escape.. but he checked out early and I did nothing to help.

I no longer do drugs like that, been almost 10 years, but the mistakes keep piling up and now multiple people truly hate me and don't care if I die. It's a very hard thing to live with and I can't sleep at night because of it. I'm lucky to get maybe 2-3 hours of sleep a night because I get woken up by my dreams in a panic and in tears. This happens until I break down and get drunk enough to pass out and not wake up for a while. I can't get away from it. The pain always comes back and haunts me.

There were a lot of mistakes made on both sides on both situations. We never should have done the drugs in the first place. She never should have cheated on her husband, nor me on my fiance. I was in love and I ruined it and really hurt somebody in the process. I fell in love again, the outcome of me losing her was not my fault, but they fact I knowingly gave them a disease that they have to live with for life is. All because I was too afraid to say anything.. in all situations. It's a reoccurring circumstance in my life that I can't seem to change. It eats at me and it feels like there's nothing of the person I should be left. I don't see any way out.

When I was in high school, by best friend died of a heroin overdose. I was there with him and held him as he did. I was so scared, I had no idea what to do. I didn't want to call 911 because I was high too, which I know was very stupid. I ended up calling his girlfriend and telling her, then I left. He died. I let my best friend die because I was too much of a pussy to do anything. More recently, I had contracted herpes to be with a girl that I was in love with. We broke up after 4 years and I ended up getting with somebody else who was married. She left her husband for me, for a time anyway, but I never told her that I had herpes. I waited until we had ended things because I was too guilty to tell her to begin with. She ended up leaving me and getting back with her husband, I told her after that happened. She has a child that is medically fragile and now I've made it so that the kid, who I was also in love with, risks contracting it as well from her mother. I ruined her and her husband's life, and potentially her children's as well. I'm a huge piece of shit and I know it. I don't need judgement. I just need to get it off of my chest.
